uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6972-7841-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing Darksteel Angel
When Darksteel Angel dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3899-6972-7153.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Arcbound Bruiser.
When Arcbound Bruiser dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Bruiser's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Bruiser from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

2099-5777-7810.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
2099-5777-7810.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing a Food.
Camellia triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Food artifact token.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability
Repeat.

225-1636-2681-7870.description:
Activate Forbidden Orchard by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Forbidden Orchard triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token under an opponent's control.
When the Spirit enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Forbidden Orchard.
Activate Hawkeye by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to the Spirit token. This'll destroy it due to it having 0 toughness.
Hawkeye triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

647-2043-7826.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Bag End Banquet that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the Bag End Banquet token enters, it triggers, creating three Food tokens.
Activate the Bag End Banquet token by tapping it, adding {C} for each Food you control.
Repeat
647-2043-7826.notes: You can reduce the cost by up to {3} if you control additional Food(s) as you start the combo. You can also tap the original Bag End Banquet for mana after the Foods are created initially if you're able to do so.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-5042-7737.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw two cards.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton
Repeat.

2457-3129-5794-7810.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-5078-7753.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Harnfel by discarding a card, exiling the top two cards of your library and allowing you to cast them this turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.

3705-5231-6896-7729.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
The Vision and Scarlet Witch triggers, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3490-5231-7429.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {R}.
Merchant of Venom triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

650-891-2511.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2011-3259-6633.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2011-3259-6633.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Najeela as attackers.
Najeela triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
2011-3259-6633.notes: Najeela can make additional Warriors if you attack with multiple each iteration. Najeela doesn't have to attack after the first iteration, as the Warrior token will trigger it.

1456-4871-5220-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
1456-4871-5220-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-2557-3899-4552-7170.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Living Brain.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

112-2365-6496.manaNeeded: {13}{U}{U}{U}{U} the first turn with {9}{U}{U}{U} each other turn
112-2365-6496.easyPrerequisites: You've cast exactly one spell this turn.
112-2365-6496.description:
Cast Expropriate by paying its mana cost.
Taigam triggers, copying Expropriate and exiling the original Expropriate with four time counters on it.
Resolve the Expropriate copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a time counter from Expropriate and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Repeat step 4 one additional time.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Expropriate's suspend ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a time counter from Expropriate and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Expropriate's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.
112-2365-6496.notes: You can use Clockspinning as a way to cast a spell before starting the combo if needed. Since you need to ensure Expropriate is always the second spell cast each extra turn after Clockspinning, it is recommended to not have any other suspended cards when beginning the combo. Otherwise, you can ensure Expropriate is second by casting Clockspinning with the other suspend abilities on the stack during your upkeep.

3259-5722-7060.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls no creatures.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature other than Wasitora.
3259-5722-7060.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent who controls no creatures using Wasitora and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Wasitora.
Resolve the Wasitora trigger, creating a 3/3 Cat Dragon creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Cat Dragon, then causing you to untap all creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat damage.

1003-2829-4053-6989.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

147-554-6797.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-554-6797.description:
Cast Extract from Darkness by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Extract from Darkness.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Extract from Darkness
Resolve the Extract from Darkness copy, causing each player to mill two cards and returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1492-2854-4574-6900.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1492-2854-4574-6900.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
1492-2854-4574-6900.description:
Cast Welding Jar either from your hand by paying {0} or from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Welding Jar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

requires.n: Vehicle with MV >= 3 and a Crew Ability

2034-5747-6243--123.easyPrerequisites:
You have enough mana to cast the Vehicle with MV >= 3.
The number of artifacts you control is equal to or greater than the Vehicle's crew number minus 2.
2034-5747-6243--123.description:
Cast the Vehicle by paying its mana cost.
When the Vehicle enters the battlefield, Simulacrum Synthesizer triggers, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token that gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control.
Activate the Vehicle's crew ability by tapping the Construct, causing the Vehicle to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Vehicle.
When the Vehicle dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning the Vehicle from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not be an Angel because the Vehicle is no longer a creature and cannot gain creature types.
When the Vehicle enters the battlefield, Simulacrum Synthesizer triggers, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token that gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent

13-4567.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 22 minus Greven's power, rounded up to the nearest multiple of 2.
13-4567.description:
Activate Selenia by paying 2 life.
Repeat step 1 until Greven has power 21 or greater due to its first ability.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Greven. The opponent loses the game due to being dealt 21 or more combat damage from your commander.

565-1858-6000--118.notablePrerequisites:
You control an animated land without summoning sickness that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control a white permanent.
565-1858-6000--118.description:
Activate an animated land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast View from Above by paying {U}, targeting the animated land.
Orvar triggers, creating a token copy of the animated land that is not a creature.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Repeat from step 2.

1912-2060-3921-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
1912-2060-3921-5140.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

1621-4605-5144.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Ephemerate.
1621-4605-5144.description:
Cast Ephemerate by paying its mana cost, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
Wispweaver Angel and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wispweaver Angel trigger, blinking another creature you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wispweaver Angel that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wispweaver Angel token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1645-1770-4826-5954.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

277-1409-1671-2895.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
277-1409-1671-2895.description:
Cast Uro by paying {1}{G}{U}
When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities trigger, as well as Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and Uro.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to draw a card, gain 3 life, and put Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Holding priority, activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Uro by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Repeat from step 2.

280-2976-4019-5227.notablePrerequisites:
Utopia Sprawl attached to Golgari Rot Farm.
Golgari Rot Farm does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Golgari Rot Farm.
"Blue" chosen with Utopia Sprawl.
280-2976-4019-5227.description:
Cast Animate Land by paying {G}, causing Golgari Rot Farm to become a creature until end of turn.
Put a +1/+1 counter on Golgari Rot Farm.
Activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Utopia Srawl triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping Golgari Rot Farm.
Repeat.

2092-2335-4289-4762.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 4 or greater.
2092-2335-4289-4762.description:
Activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron by paying {R}{G}, giving all other creatures you control +1/+1, trample and haste until end of turn.
Activate Devoted Druid and Barrenton Medic by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Devoted Druid and Barrenton Medic's second abilities by putting a -1/-1 counter on them, untapping them.
Repeat.

751-3257-3314-3875.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Tireless Provisioner.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

409-4377-4797.notablePrerequisites: Tormod's Cryptkeeper does not have summoning sickness.
409-4377-4797.description:
Activate Tormod's Crpyt by tapping and sacrificing it, exiling your graveyard.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Deadbridge Chant triggers, returning Walk the Aeons to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2.
NOTE: This combo can fail if other cards enter your graveyard after step 1.

4050-4629-4776.notablePrerequisites: You have the highest life total.
4050-4629-4776.description:
Activate Pyrohemia by paying {R}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
Sprouting Phytohydra triggers, creating a token copy of itself.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the damaged Sprouting Phytohydra, adding {R}.
Repeat until each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

185-3098-4074-4377.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U} on each odd-numbered turn, with at most {3}{U} available each even-numbered turn
185-3098-4074-4377.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast an instant or sorcery this turn.
185-3098-4074-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}.
Chandra triggers, copying Walk the Aeons.
Resolve both Walk the Aeonss, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast etiher Mystic Retrieval or Call to Mind by paying its mana cost, targeting either Call to Mind or Mystic Retrieval in your graveyard.
Chandra triggers, copying Call to Mind or Mystic Retrieval, targeting Walk the Aeons.
Resolve both Call to Minds or Mystic Retrievals, returning Walk the Aeons and either Call to Mind or Mystic Retrieval from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.

527-2059-3657.notablePrerequisites: Selvala does not have summoning sickness.
527-2059-3657.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {4}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Kogla by paying {1}{G}, returning Village Bell-Ringer from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Village Bell-Ringer by paying {2}{W}.
Village Bell-Ringer enters the battlefield, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

2034-3661-4535-5224.description:
Cast Shield Sphere.
Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Shield Sphere.
 Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, making it so the next time Shield Sphere dies this turn, it returns to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Shield Sphere, adding {2}.
Together Forever triggers, returning Shield Sphere to your hand.
Repeat.

2060-2265-2854-2908.notablePrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds has 2 or 3 lore counters on it.
2060-2265-2854-2908.description:
Cast Dream Stalker, putting 2 +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler with Showdown of the Skalds.
Remove 2 +1/+1 counter from Crystalline Crawler to add {1}{U}.
Dream Stalker triggers, returning itself to your hand.
Repeat.
